notes: The versional and alternative-rendering notes were read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
The supplied *unto* before בֵית־יְהוָה and the supplied *in* before שִׁלוֹ belong to those bare nominals, whose case-function licenses them, the verb's own object being the suffix (rules 33, 44).
The supplied *of* before קֶמַח states what the measure nominal contributes and goes to the word it stands before (rule 33).
